title: The Masked Advantage: Uncovering Local-Language Access to Cultural Knowledge in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses a 'difference-in-differences' framework with a 1PL Item Response Theory (IRT) model to compare model ability on culture-specific questions versus culture-agnostic questions, isolating the 'KnowledgeGap' to measure access to localized cultural knowledge.

The study calculates 'GlobalGap' by comparing model performance on culture-agnostic items in English versus local languages, measuring the extent of English-centric language proficiency and its impact on knowledge retrieval.
